approach: Option B (full removal) of the Scout Debug map control, keeping config('app.scanner_debug_map_enabled') in place solely for scanPaths() debug coloring. Single-node fast path (no worktree fan-out) — the change is one cohesive removal whose files are interdependent (removing store exports requires removing their consumers in the same pass to keep the build green), with no sensitive-glob blast radius.

subtasks.title: Remove the Scout Debug map control (UI + precision/satellite backend), keep scanner_debug_map_enabled for scanPaths
subtasks.approach: Frontend: delete DebugMapControls.vue; strip its wiring from DashboardOverlay.vue; remove the dead store state/fns + precision params from map.js; drop mapType init + the two debug watchers from ScannerMap.vue (basemap defaults to roadmap); remove the debugMapEnabled config injection from both blade shells. Backend: delete resolveDebugPrecision() + the precision validation rule from ScoutMapHelpers; in both ClarityScoutMapController and ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController hardcode precision=7 at heatmapHits/heatmapOrders (NOT delete the param — the CH query classes fall back to 6 when absent) and drop the inline precision validation rule. Tests: remove the debug-precision honor/ignore/range tests, KEEP the precision-7-default pin, ADD a precision-7 test for Bird's Eye, flip the shell-view debugMapEnabled assertSee->assertDontSee. Update config/app.php's scanner_debug_map_enabled doc-comment (flag stays, now only gates scanPaths) and the okf doc that names resolveDebugPrecision(). TDD the backend (precision-7 pins go red->green); frontend verified via npm run build + browser QA (no JS test runner).
